---
name: Architecture or dependency review
about: Review a design, licensing choice or external component
title: "[ADR/Audit] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Problem and proposed decision
What is blocked or uncertain?

## Alternatives and sources
Link to upstream repositories, version/tag, docs and license files.

## Analysis
Include maintainability, hosting costs, security, privacy, licensing, accessibility, operational load and vendor lock-in.

## Validation / experiment
What small reproducible experiment could resolve the uncertainty?

## Recommendation, fallback and migration path
State what you would choose, why and how to reverse it.

## Owner approval needed
Identify legal, budget or infrastructure decisions requiring maintainer approval.
